speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Given your symptoms of fatigue, night sweats, weight loss, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, I need to ask a few questions to narrow this down. Have you noticed any specific changes in your skin, such as yellowing or darkening, or any jaundice?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for confirming the weight loss and sweats. To better localize the source of your illness, have you experienced any fever, cough, or changes in your bowel habits alongside the abdominal pain? Also, do you have a history of alcohol use or recent travel?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma with possible hepatic involvement or metastatic malignancy. I recommend an urgent CT scan of the chest, abdomen, and pelvis, along with a lymph node biopsy for confirmation.
